verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.aws.amazon.com that gives structured access to AWS service documentation for large language models. They also confirm that a markdown (.md) rendition of the Amazon Chime SDK developer guide page is served, which an agent can consume directly. missing for 10: a Chime SDK-specific llms.txt rather than only the AWS-wide one, evidence that markdown renditions cover the full Chime SDK docs beyond a single probed page, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
